title: Trees And Plants 6th Degree Summary Declaration Of Divine Unity

questions.question: What main message do all kinds of trees and plants agree on in this passage?
questions.answer: They all point to Allah’s oneness and necessary existence.

questions.question: Which parts of trees and plants are described like they are speaking?
questions.answer: Their leaves, flowers, and fruits.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the kindness and giving seen in trees and plants?
questions.answer: It says their blessings and gifts show purposeful mercy and generosity.

questions.question: How are the many different kinds of plants described: as random or as made with wisdom and choice?
questions.answer: They are described as made with wisdom and choice.

questions.question: What does the passage teach by mentioning beauty and decoration in plants?
questions.answer: Their beauty shows careful design, not accident.

questions.question: What do the seeds and grains have in common at the start?
questions.answer: They are similar to one another and limited in number.

questions.question: What surprising change happens from those similar seeds and grains?
questions.answer: Many different, beautiful, and balanced forms come out from them.

questions.question: Why is that change from similar seeds to many different plants important?
questions.answer: It is a clear sign of Allah’s power, wisdom, and will.

questions.question: Which is greater in number in the passage: the forms of plants or the seeds they come from?
questions.answer: The forms of plants are far more varied, while the seeds are limited.

questions.question: What two qualities are joined with Allah’s acts of making plants different and beautiful?
questions.answer: Will and wisdom.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the order of leaves, flowers, and fruits?
questions.answer: It describes them as balanced, beautiful, and well-arranged.

questions.question: What is one strong reason this passage gives for believing in one Creator?
questions.answer: Similar seeds producing countless different plant forms in an orderly way shows one wise Creator.

questions.question: Who is being glorified by all the species of trees and plants in the passage?
questions.answer: Allah is being glorified.

questions.question: What does the agreement of all plant species point to?
questions.answer: It points to Allah’s existence and His oneness.

questions.question: What are leaves compared to in the passage?
questions.answer: They are compared to meaningful words.

questions.question: How are flowers presented in the passage?
questions.answer: They are shown as beautiful signs that speak in their own way.

questions.question: How are fruits presented in the passage?
questions.answer: They are shown as orderly and meaningful signs.

questions.question: What does “purposeful mercy” mean here in a simple way?
questions.answer: It means Allah gives blessings to plants with care and a reason.

questions.question: What does the passage say about making plants different from each other?
questions.answer: Their differences are made deliberately, not by chance.

questions.question: What does adornment in plants help prove?
questions.answer: It helps prove that their Maker acts with wisdom and beauty.

questions.question: From what simple beginnings do many plant forms open up?
questions.answer: They open up from seeds and grains.

questions.question: Are those seeds and grains described as all wildly different or mostly alike?
questions.answer: They are described as mostly alike.

questions.question: What can we infer when similar seeds produce countless different forms?
questions.answer: We can infer that a knowing and powerful Creator directs them.

questions.question: What group in creation is the focus of this passage?
questions.answer: The passage focuses on trees and plants.

questions.question: What shared testimony do they give?
questions.answer: They all bear witness to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: Name the three plant features used as signs in the passage.
questions.answer: Leaves, flowers, and fruits.

questions.question: What quality of the leaves is emphasized?
questions.answer: Their balance and order are emphasized.

questions.question: What quality of the flowers is emphasized?
questions.answer: Their beauty and lovely appearance are emphasized.

questions.question: What quality of the fruits is emphasized?
questions.answer: Their orderly and meaningful form is emphasized.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Allah’s giving to creation?
questions.answer: It says His giving is full of bounty, honor, and kindness.

questions.question: Is the generosity shown in plants described as careless or intentional?
questions.answer: It is described as intentional.

questions.question: What three actions show careful design in plants besides giving blessings?
questions.answer: Making them different, beautifying them, and shaping them.

questions.question: What do these actions show about the Creator?
questions.answer: They show that the Creator has will and wisdom.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention that seeds are few and limited?
questions.answer: To show that countless plant forms come from small, limited beginnings.

questions.question: How does the ending idea about endless plant forms strengthen faith?
questions.answer: It shows that only Allah can bring so much variety and order from such similar seeds.

questions.question: According to the passage, do trees and plants testify alone or together?
questions.answer: They testify together, in agreement.

questions.question: What belief do they support together?
questions.answer: They support belief in Allah alone.

questions.question: Why are leaves, flowers, and fruits mentioned one after another?
questions.answer: To show that many parts of plants all give the same message.

questions.question: What does the orderly look of plant parts teach us?
questions.answer: It teaches that they were arranged with care and wisdom.

questions.question: What does the passage connect with mercy?
questions.answer: It connects mercy with Allah’s gifts and blessings in plants.

questions.question: What does the passage connect with will and wisdom?
questions.answer: It connects will and wisdom with making plants different, decorated, and shaped.

questions.question: If something is done with wisdom, is it pointless or meaningful?
questions.answer: It is meaningful.

questions.question: How are the forms of plants described after they grow?
questions.answer: They are balanced, decorated, varied, and too many to count.

questions.question: How are the seeds described before that growth?
questions.answer: They are similar, limited, and countable.

questions.question: What contrast is the passage asking us to notice?
questions.answer: It asks us to notice that many different plant forms come from simple, similar seeds.

questions.question: Why is this contrast important for understanding Tawhid?
questions.answer: It shows one wise Lord is controlling and designing all of it.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the whole passage in one sentence?
questions.answer: The beauty, order, generosity, and variety in plants all point to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What does the passage say the whole plant world agrees about?
questions.answer: It agrees that Allah alone is the true God.

questions.question: In the passage, how do plants “speak” without talking like people?
questions.answer: They speak through their form, beauty, order, and the blessings they carry.

questions.question: What do balanced leaves suggest about their Maker?
questions.answer: They suggest careful planning and wisdom.

questions.question: What do lovely flowers suggest about their Maker?
questions.answer: They suggest beauty, generosity, and mercy.

questions.question: What do well-formed fruits suggest about their Maker?
questions.answer: They suggest order, purpose, and beneficial giving.

questions.question: What three ideas of giving are highlighted in the passage?
questions.answer: Bestowal, bounty, and generosity.

questions.question: Are these gifts described as happening without purpose?
questions.answer: No, they are described as given with purpose and mercy.

questions.question: What three ideas of design are highlighted in the passage?
questions.answer: Difference, adornment, and shaping.

questions.question: What supports these design choices according to the passage?
questions.answer: Will and wisdom support them.

questions.question: What kind of beginning do many plant forms come from?
questions.answer: They come from seeds and grains that are similar and limited.

questions.question: What does the phrase about unlimited forms help us understand?
questions.answer: It helps us understand the amazing variety Allah brings out in creation.

questions.question: If a student wanted one proof from this passage that creation is not random, what could he or she say?
questions.answer: Similar seeds growing into many different, beautiful, and orderly plants is a strong proof that creation is not random.

questions.question: Which living things are giving testimony in this passage?
questions.answer: All species of trees and plants are giving testimony.

questions.question: What are they testifying to?
questions.answer: They are testifying to Allah’s existence and oneness.

questions.question: What example from plants shows clear order?
questions.answer: Their leaves, flowers, and fruits are arranged in a balanced and organized way.

questions.question: What example from plants shows beauty?
questions.answer: Their flowers and other decorated forms show beauty.

questions.question: What example from plants shows provision and kindness?
questions.answer: Their fruits and the blessings found in them show provision and kindness.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention mercy together with giving?
questions.answer: To show that Allah’s gifts are caring and purposeful.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention wisdom together with shaping and decorating?
questions.answer: To show that plant forms are made thoughtfully and not by accident.

questions.question: What is special about the seeds and grains before they grow?
questions.answer: They are small, limited, and very similar to one another.

questions.question: What is special about the forms that come out after they grow?
questions.answer: They become many different kinds, with beauty, balance, and variety.

questions.question: What does this teach about Allah’s power?
questions.answer: It teaches that Allah can bring endless variety from simple beginnings.
